description: A dermatophyte fungal infection whose appearance has been modified or obscured by eczema-like inflammation.
causes: Dermatophyte infection with an eczematous appearance
risk_factors: Previous topical corticosteroid exposure may alter the clinical appearance

appearance.general: Inflamed, scaly lesions may lack the classic border of untreated tinea.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether fungal examination or testing is needed when a presumed eczema lesion is atypical or persistent.
